authority: MPES Sections 13.5 and 22.7; tool output is evidence, not legal truth
policy: No dependency is admitted from a package name alone.
License and source obligations are evaluated at exact source/version and distribution profile.
Copyleft or ambiguous obligations require isolation/compliance evidence or explicit rejection before release.
Automated ORT, ScanCode, REUSE/SPDX, or equivalent results are reviewed rather than treated as legal truth.

automatedGate.command: npm run audit:licenses; npm run audit:security
automatedGate.scope: all node_modules entries in package-lock.json plus current high-severity npm advisory data
